author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 열매 달린 나무가 있는 숲 가장자리와 농경지
summary: 국내에서는 2006년 11월 소청도에서 개똥지빠귀 무리에 섞여 날아가는 한 마리가 처음 확인되었고, 2009년 1월 철원에서 사진으로 기록된 길잃은새다. 아이슬란드와 북유럽에서 시베리아를 거쳐 동쪽으로 번식하나 예니세이강 동쪽에서는 드물고, 겨울에는 유럽 남부와 북아프리카, 서남아시아로 내려간다. 겨울에는 무리를 지어 다른 지빠귀들과 함께 열매 달린 나무와 덤불에 모인다.
young: 어린새는 등과 어깨깃에 담황색 세로 반점이 있고 아랫면이 얼룩덜룩하며, 옆구리와 날개아랫덮깃의 적갈색이 어른새보다 흐리다. 첫겨울깃은 어른새와 비슷하나 큰날개덮깃과 셋째날개깃 끝에 옅은 반점이 있다.

similar.how: 개똥지빠귀는 날개깃과 날개덮깃에 적갈색이 많고 가슴과 옆구리에 검은 비늘무늬가 있으나, 붉은날개지빠귀는 날개가 갈색이고 아랫면에 세로줄 무늬가 있으며 옆구리가 적갈색이다.

art.subject: Redwing (Turdus iliacus), adult in winter (sexes alike): upperparts plain warm olive-brown; a long creamy-white supercilium; dark brown ear-coverts bordered below by a whitish submoustachial stripe and a dark malar stripe; underparts whitish with dense dark brown streaks arranged in lines on the throat sides, breast and flanks; a deep rusty-red patch on the flanks extending onto the underwing coverts; undertail coverts white; bill dark with a yellow base to the lower mandible; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: feeding on red berries in a bare shrub, side view
art.scene: berry-laden shrubs at a farmland edge in Korea in winter, frost on dry grass and low sun; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view standing on the ground: long creamy-white supercilium, dark brown ear-coverts, plain brown upperparts, white underparts with lines of dark brown streaks, rusty-red flanks, dark bill with a yellow base to the lower mandible, pinkish legs

adult in flight seen squarely from below: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, rusty-red underwing coverts, creamy supercilium, streaked white breast, rusty-red flanks, pale feet tucked against the belly
art.build: A small, compact thrush, smaller than a Dusky Thrush and slightly smaller than a White-cheeked Starling, with a rounded head and a fairly short tail. Bill straight, slightly shorter than the head. Legs medium, pinkish-brown. Tail medium, square, plain brown. In flight shows rusty-red underwing coverts.
avoid: Do not paint the red on the breast; it is confined to the flanks and underwing.
Do not paint chestnut wing panels or black-spotted breast bands (Dusky Thrush, Turdus eunomus).
Do not omit the strong creamy supercilium; the face is boldly striped.
Do not paint round spots; the markings are streaks in lines.
